info.title: Casting42 Universal API
info.description: Manage casting talent records, media, and candidates.

post.description: Creates a Casting42 authentication token from your API key.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

accessToken.description: Short-lived bearer token returned by Casting42 for normal API calls.

authenticated.description: Whether the Casting42 API key exchange succeeded.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the exchanged bearer token expires when derivable from the Expiry header.

expiresOn.description: Parsed expiration timestamp from the Casting42 Expiry response header when available.
